name: RealSummary
query:
select dept.Name               as Name
,      min(emp.DateOfBirth)    as MinDateOfBirth
,      max(emp.DateOfBirth)    as MaxDateOfBirth
,      sum(emp.Salary)         as TotalSalary
,      avg(emp.Salary)         as AvgSalary
,      min(emp.Salary)         as MinSalary
from   Hr.Department           as dept
       full outer join dept/Hr.Employee_Department/Hr.Employee as emp
group  by dept.Name
order  by dept.Name

name: RealNested
query:
select Name as Name
,      MinDateOfBirth as MinDateOfBirth
,      MaxDateOfBirth as MaxDateOfBirth
,      TotalSalary as TotalSalary
,      AvgSalary as  AvgSalary
,      MinSalary as MinSalary
from   (
select dept.Name               as Name
,      min(emp.DateOfBirth)    as MinDateOfBirth
,      max(emp.DateOfBirth)    as MaxDateOfBirth
,      sum(emp.Salary)         as TotalSalary
,      avg(emp.Salary)         as AvgSalary
,      min(emp.Salary)         as MinSalary
from   Hr.Department           as dept
       full outer join dept/Hr.Employee_Department/Hr.Employee as emp
group  by dept.Name
) as temp
order  by temp.MinDateOfBirth

name: NameAsc
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY e.Name

name: NameDesc
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY Name DESC

name: DecimalAsc
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY TotalSalary, Name

name: DecimalDesc
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY TotalSalary DESC, Name DESC

name: DateAsc
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY MinDateOfBirth ASC, Name

name: DateDesc
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY MinDateOfBirth DESC, Name

name: Page
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY Name LIMIT 3 OFFSET 2

name: OffsetOnly
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY Name OFFSET 6

name: ZeroLimit
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY Name LIMIT 0

name: EmptyRows
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e WHERE e.Name = 'Nobody' ORDER BY Name

name: AggregateEmpty
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS RowsCount, SUM(e.Salary) AS TotalSalary FROM Hr.Employee e WHERE e.Name = 'Nobody'

name: AliasAggregate
query: SELECT e.DepartmentName AS Name, COUNT(*) AS RowsCount FROM Hr.Employee e GROUP BY e.DepartmentName ORDER BY RowsCount DESC, Name

name: DerivedPage
query: SELECT t.Name AS Name, t.TotalSalary AS TotalSalary FROM (SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY Name DESC LIMIT 4) t ORDER BY Name

name: DerivedFilter
query: SELECT t.Name AS Name FROM (SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS TotalSalary, e.DateOfBirth AS MinDateOfBirth FROM Hr.Employee e) t WHERE t.TotalSalary >= 10 ORDER BY Name

name: DuplicateRows
query: SELECT d.Name AS Name FROM Hr.Department d ORDER BY Name

name: IgnoredColumn
query: SELECT e.Name AS Name, e.Salary AS Ignored FROM Hr.Employee e ORDER BY Name
